items.title: Chapter 14 — I/O
items.description: Complete guide to Java I/O: NIO.2 Path/Files API, classic java.io streams, BufferedReader/Writer, serialization (transient, serialVersionUID), directory walking with Files.walk(), file watching with WatchService, and common exam traps around stream closing and null returns.

items.title: Java I/O: Streams, NIO & I/O Models
items.description: Guide to Java I/O, including stream APIs, NIO channels and buffers, file handling, and I/O model fundamentals.
